tool_input.command:
q(){ docker exec postgres psql -U postgres -d cchist -A -F '|' -c "$1"; }
q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Write' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark"
q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Bash' AND r.denied_mark"
q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM human_message h JOIN message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 16 AND 17"
q "SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Bash' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark) / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name = 'Bash'), 0) AS pct"
q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'NotebookEdit', 'MultiEdit') AND c.is_sidechain"
q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error"
q "WITH c AS (SELECT h.file_id, h.line_no, h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative AS is_q, lead(h.line_no) OVER (PARTITION BY h.file_id ORDER BY h.line_no) AS next_line FROM human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0) SELECT count(*) AS n FROM c WHERE c.is_q AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tool_call t WHERE t.file_id = c.file_id AND t.line_no > c.line_no AND (c.next_line IS NULL OR t.line_no < c.next_line) AND NOT t.is_sidechain)"
q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND c.is_sidechain"
q "SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND c.model = 'claude-opus-4-8') / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND c.model = 'claude-opus-4-8'), 0) AS pct"
q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tool_call c WHERE NOT c.is_sidechain AND c.model = 'claude-sonnet-4-6'"
q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND c.ts >= '2026-07-01 00:00+00' AND c.ts < '2026-08-01 00:00+00'"
q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND r.ts >= '2026-07-01 00:00+00' AND r.ts < '2026-08-01 00:00+00'"
q "SELECT h.model, count(*) AS n FROM human_message h JOIN message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 12 AND 15 GROUP BY 1"
q "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM call_danger_hit d JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = d.call_id WHERE NOT c.is_sidechain"
q "SELECT column_name, table_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND (column_name ILIKE '%token%' OR column_name ILIKE '%text%' OR column_name ILIKE '%word%' OR column_name ILIKE '%content%')"
tool_input.description: Run certified queries for all questions
